about: The re-grip into two hands (KE task 10, D15): the two-handed guard's first 9 frames (0.3 s, the owner's length), starting in the one-handed guard's first pose and carried into the two-handed guard, the off hand joining the handle, the feet where the guard has them. Played on the upper body over the legs on a switch to two hands while standing, moving or guarding; the rules' switch is instant, so this is picture only. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
